featured_reviews.name: Karyn
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been working out with Studio Burrn by Shefale S, for almost a year. It has been a great experience here for me. If you are new to fitness or already into fitness, there is a journey of growth in your health routine.
The great selling points are:
1. Combination Programs of a variety of exercises from strength training, tabata, spin bike, HIIT, Cross FIT to name a few among many more. They are structured in a group format.
2. Floor trainers to walk you through the routine (esp. If you are a beginner ) and also encouraging you to increase your difficulty level ( if your are in intermediate or advance).
3. The flexibility of timing is a big win where once you clock in you join in the routine and complete the full session in an hr.
4. If you do happen to take a break, you can adjust your tempo to beginner level by doing the work out at an intensity that suits you as it's meant for all levels of fitness . This helps you to bring your momentum back where you don't feel an over load of starting off with something intense.
5. Women in Perimenopause (35 to 40 years +)would find it very beneficial as it has weights and strength training which is so crucial for that phase.
6. It's better than paying for a gym membership and having to figure out what routine of training you want to do when Studio Burrn does that for you and with the trainer on floor guiding you through it in a group.
Surely give Studio Burrn a try. I highly recommend it.
Thank you Shefale for such a practicle format. Best wishes
From,
A Lover of fitness for around 20 years and been into it actively post COVID.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I was never really into fitness before joining Fitness Den. One random day while sitting in my office, I decided that it was finally time to start focusing on my health and fitness. I searched for several gyms and came across Fitness Den by Suhas Khamkar. I called them and scheduled a gym visit.

The moment I entered the gym, I instantly felt that this was the right place for me. The ambience, energy, and overall environment were extremely motivating. During my visit, I met Vishakha from the front desk, who guided me very well and offered me a great membership package.

On my very first day, I met Trainer Mohsin Ali, who is now my Personal Trainer. From day one, his guidance was exceptional. Initially, I had no intention of taking personal training, but after interacting with him and understanding his approach towards fitness and health, I felt confident that I should take PT sessions.

That decision truly changed things for me. Mohsin Sir advised me to get certain blood tests done. Although I looked fine externally, the reports revealed high cholesterol, triglycerides, and uric acid levels. I was honestly shocked. When I shared the reports with Mohsin Sir, he calmly said, “Don’t panic, we will reverse it with proper training and discipline.”

From that moment, my mindset completely changed. I became determined to work on myself seriously, and with Mohsin Sir’s constant guidance, motivation, and training, I have started seeing real results. He helped me transform not just physically, but mentally as well — from being careless about my health to becoming someone who genuinely takes care of his body and lifestyle.

The ambience, and overall atmosphere at Fitness Den are excellent, and the trainers are highly supportive and knowledgeable. Joining this gym has truly been one of the best decisions for my health and fitness journey.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavik Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined AISW one year ago.

On my very first day, I met a trainer who was calm, composed, and deeply confident in what he knew. He understood exactly what I needed, even before I could explain it properly myself. I signed up with him as my personal trainer immediately.

That trainer was Veeraj Sir.

Before we even started training seriously, he tested my body strength, stamina, mobility, and muscle capacity. There was never any rush. His philosophy was simple: progress slowly, but correctly. Every workout had purpose. Warm-ups and stretches were just as important to him as lifting weights.

And somehow, through an entire year of training, I never dealt with the kind of post-workout pain or injuries people usually talk about.

When I joined, I was overweight. Honestly, I still am… just a few kilos less now 😄
But I’ve already lost 15 kgs.

Today, I can box squat 70 kgs without pain. My chest, biceps, core, stamina, and overall strength are in a much better place.

But the biggest transformation was not physical.

My daily medicines reduced from 7 to just 2.
My blood pressure medicines disappeared.
No diabetes medication anymore.
Even my doctor asked me to stop taking multivitamins.

I feel energetic again.
I’m playing the best cricket of my life.
And most importantly…
I ended my long, exhausting relationship with back pain.

That alone changed my quality of life.

Veeraj Sir didn’t just help me lose weight. He helped me regain confidence in my own body again.

One year later, I can genuinely say that one of the things that impressed me most about him is his deep understanding of the science of the human body. The way he explains muscle function, recovery, movement, posture, and overall physiology makes you realize that his training is not random — every exercise has a scientific reason behind it. He understands how the body works and adapts, and that knowledge reflects in the safe, effective, and sustainable progress his clients make.

Now I’m looking forward to another year under his guidance. This next year feels less about fitness and more about transformation.

And honestly, the biggest compliment I can give him is this:
I’m already trying to convince my son to train under him during his school vacations ❤️

Thank you, Veeraj Sir.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you, Bhavik. Transformations like these are built through patience, trust and consistent effort over time. Your journey - from improved strength and mobility to better overall health - is a powerful reminder of what structured training can achieve. Veeraj will be deeply grateful for your words. Wishing you an even stronger year ahead at AISW Ghatkopar.
